title: Compare
concept: Compare numbers with > and < to make a condition

steps.say: We want 2 gems left. This takes them all. Run it and see.
`>` compares: is the count more than 2?
Use the comparison as the condition. Run it.
`<` adds until there are 6. Run it.
After `move()`, add `while gems_here() > 1:` with `pick()` inside. Not `if`: piles need several picks.
The start cell counts too. Trim it before the walk.
Run it. Whole piles gone? Check the number after `>`. First pile too big? Trim it before the walk.

guided.done: One gem left on every pile, whatever its size.

recap.say: A comparison is a condition: `while gems_here() > 1:` repeats while the count is more than 1.

big_piles_only: Compare your result with the Goal view: which piles should stay? And is the cell the robot starts on right?
Decide once per cell with an `if` and a comparison, then clear the whole pile with a `while`.
level_piles: Look at the Goal view: every cell ends with 2 gems, even empty ones.
A cell can have too few or too many. What loop adds until there are enough? What loop takes until only 2 are left?
